summary: Full backend+frontend regression of the new RND Samples (Labdip/Handfeel/Proofing) board+studio flow on ent_ksc. Backend pytest 5/5 pass (list w/ stats, sample-types meta, create labdip+handfeel, PATCH add proofing => 400 expected 'requires design', cancel). Frontend flows all pass: rnd-samples-view + KPIs (Total 34, Terkirim 4, Dikerjakan 1, Ada ACC 2, Pemenang 21, Overdue 5) match stats API; board 5 columns + counts + cards; type filter (proofing => 1 sample => 4 nested testids), status chips, list tab (34 rows), search, create modal 3 sections with type-gated save (disabled when no type chosen), auto-open detail after create (KSC/SMP-00035), tabs labdip/handfeel/proofing rendered, add-proofing button PATCHes and shows expected error notice 'Proofing WAJIB merujuk kode desain', send modal opens with types + supplier list + confirm (status -> 'Terkirim ke supplier', 1 round row created), cancel flow via confirm-modal + reason => status 'Dibatalkan' + stepper pill. MD role: sees view, create button, and send button on detail. Cleanup: cancelled all TEST_QA3 leftover samples.
critical_code_review_comments: SampleSendModal exposes a single testid 'sample-send-supplier-list' rather than per-supplier 'sample-send-supplier-<id>' as the spec/testids doc mentions. Selection still works (auto-picked when 1 supplier), but per-item testids would improve test targeting when multiple suppliers exist.

Initial KPI render shows 0 for total/sent for ~200ms before stats API resolves; consider showing skeleton or dashes rather than 0 to avoid confusing snapshots (screenshot captured 0 momentarily during automation).
seed_data_creation: Created and cancelled TEST_QA3 samples (KSC/SMP-00033..00035). All cancelled at end of testing; no residual live TEST_ samples remain.
context_for_next_testing_agent: RND sample board+studio flow verified end-to-end. Note SampleSendModal uses supplier-list testid (not per-supplier). Add-proofing on labdip+handfeel sample deliberately returns 400 (requires design) and error is surfaced via sample-detail-error notice. Round-level submit/assess/decide/finish paths not fully exercised (require complex master data); the round-row+upload+submit testids do render after send.
